verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de's documents say businesses can 'submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows'. Its notarization endpoint auto-detects signature fields with AI, and webhooks report signing events. This suggests multi-signer document flows, but they are notary-mediated certification rather than a general e-signature product. Missing for 10: explicit sending of e-signature requests to multiple recipients, routing or signing order, an independent or hands-on check of the signer flow, and a statement of which e-signature legal standard applies.
